fields.gap: Joint and seam mass at the 009 SiC point: 89.2 to 3004.3 kg across panel sizes 4 m to 0.25 m, against the 216.427 kg five percent allowance. Only 4 m panels, which do not exist in SiC today (PROJECTION), fit; today's 0.5 m Hexoloy plate size is 330 to 694 percent of the allowance; conservative 0.25 m tiling leaves the hull 966 to 2543 kg heavy.
fields.direction: Pin the real maximum Hexoloy SA plate size from the manufacturer, and produce a seam parts list (doubler, adhesive, core splice) for a named panel size; or re-run the point on a face family whose sheet widths are 2 to 4 m today (aluminium, CFRP layup).
fields.effect: Decides alone whether the 009 point floats; up to 1388 percent of the joint allowance.
